This extension may conflict with other programs similar in functionality.
Conflicted addons:

* Tab Open/Close Control
* OneTab
* Tiled Tab Groups
* Totally not Panorama (Tab Groups with tab hiding)
* Panorama Tab Groups
* Panorama View (etc.)
